verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Workable serves an llms.txt at its ReadMe docs root (HTTP 200) with a documentation index. Individual reference pages are also available as markdown (.md) and point agents to that index, so an agent can be aimed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all spec paths 404 and download is disabled), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://workable.readme.io/llms.txt # Workable Documentation
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://workable.readme.io/llms.
